title: Cody, WY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cody, WY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cody is a city in WY with a population of 10,000. Wild West gateway to Yellowstone with the Buffalo Bill Center of the West. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
